objective: Replace selected-vacancy DOCX generation with single explicit-click ChatGPT private MCP flow; preserve validated facts and one renderer.
acceptance: 1 - Trigger CV generation only after click on existing button
2 - Zero OpenAI API charges and no dependency on local GPU
3 - Reuse persisted vacancy description and verified career facts
4 - Use one renderer and no duplicated legacy generation API
5 - Validate evidence IDs and audit reopened DOCX
6 - Private bearer authentication and expiring signed link
7 - Build and unit tests plus live MCP authentication and user DOCX must pass before final homologation
8 - Strict allowlist of changed files; keep unrelated functions stable
deployment: Do not merge to main or deploy until isolated gate checks and integrated homologation are complete.
